decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The finished floor levels of the development to which this permission relates shall be no lower than those of the existing building(s) and any electrical sockets or other electrical fittings within the development shall be installed no lower than 750mm above finished floor level.Reason: To mitigate the risks associated with flooding of the site, in accordance with policy SI12 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS1 and DM4 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

A minimum of 3 swift bricks must be incorporated within the external walls of the development hereby approved prior to occupation and must be retained thereafter.Reason: To enhance the biodiversity of the site in accordance with the Kingston Swift (Flagship) Species Action Plan (2023), Policy DM6 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012) and Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021).

Prior the commencement of any development above ground level, detailed drawings at a scale of 1:20  of the following features shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority :- Elevational drawings of the proposed replacement  windows to the host dwelling and installation of new windows in proposed extension (including manufacturer specification). Including details of thermal efficiency, dimensions and colour.- Soldier course header including materials- Details of window reveals/ recesses ( these to be the same as the existing windows)The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and drawings.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan and policies CS8 and DM10  of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The works shall be carried out and maintained in accordance with the deposited Fire Statement compliant with Policy D12(A).Reason: In the interests of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire Safety) of the London Plan 2021.

The installation and placement of proposed new windows and door openings within the host dwelling and adjoining two storey extension are to match with the architecural style and positioning of the facades of the existing terrace houses.  In addition, the  material specification for the new roof covering for both the existing host dwelling and the proposed extension should match to ensure consistency.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan and policies CS8 and DM10  of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) (or any Order revoking and reenacting that Order with or without modification), no windows shall be inserted nor any other openings formed (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) at  ground and first floor level or above in the Proposed Side (Right) Elevation (Drawing No D.PR.3.4) of the 1 Victoria Road , Kingston upon Thanes, KT1 3DW unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
description: Erection of two storey side extension, relocation of main entrance, alteration to front bay. Installation of 1no rear rooflight.
